name: gleech
description: Universal image glitching and 3-bit dithering engine for Node.js and browser canvas (fork of Glitchy3bitDither)

scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('.nojekyll', ''); fs.copyFileSync('dist/main.js', 'main.js'); fs.cpSync('dist/assets', 'assets', {recursive:true});"
scripts.lint: node --check index.js bin/gleech src/main.js src/core/glitch-engine.js src/core/canvas-utils.js src/workers/glitch.worker.js src/workers/worker-pool.js
scripts.test: node --check index.js && ./bin/gleech list && node -e "import('./index.js').then(m => console.log('gleech OK with', m.gleech.all.length, 'algorithms'))"
